findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: modern_slavery, ofsted_report, post_ofsted_report, cqc_report, charity_report, post_idv_check, post_watch · Private data: public_record, post_watch, put_watch_webhook, accounts, aml_register_changes, website_legal, post_effects · Public sink: post_batch, post_assess, post_modern_slavery, post_ofsted_report, post_cqc_report, post_charity_report, post_idv_check, post_watch, put_watch_webhook, watch_webhook, delete_watch_webhook, will_they_pay, post_effects, post_distress_signals, payment_practices · Destructive: delete_watch, delete_watch_webhook, post_effects, delete_effects.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: modern_slavery, ofsted_report, post_ofsted_report, cqc_report, charity_report, post_idv_check, post_watch · Private data: public_record, post_watch, put_watch_webhook, accounts, aml_register_changes, website_legal, post_effects · Public sink: post_batch, post_assess, post_modern_slavery, post_ofsted_report, post_cqc_report, post_charity_report, post_idv_check, post_watch, put_watch_webhook, watch_webhook, delete_watch_webhook, will_they_pay, post_effects, post_distress_signals, payment_practices · Destructive: delete_watch, delete_watch_webhook, post_effects, delete_effects

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
